8 . I will add a good example employed by N. Ossipow to illustrate the difference between a superstitious, a psychoanalytic and a mystic concept (‘Psychoanalyse und Aberglauben’ [‘Psychoanalysis and Superstition’], Internationale Zeitschrift für Psychoanalyse VIII, 1922). Ossipow had married in a small Russian provincial town, and directly afterwards travelled to Moscow with his young wife. At a station two hours from their journey’s end, he felt a wish to go out of the station and take a look at the town. He thought the train would be stopping long enough, but when he came back a few minutes later it had already left, with his wife on board. On hearing of this accident, his old nurse at home said, shaking her head: ‘Dear me, that marriage will never turn out well.’ At the time Ossipow laughed at her prophecy. But since he separated from his wife five months later, he could not help, in retrospect, seeing his leaving the train as an ‘unconscious protest’ against the marriage. The town where he committed this slip acquired great importance for him years later, since it was the home of someone else with whom he was to be linked closely. The very existence of this person was entirely unknown to him at the time. But the mystic explanation of his conduct would be that he had left the train to Moscow, with his wife on it, in that particular town because of a premonition that he was to enter a relationship with that other person in the future.

8. 我将补充一个N. Ossipow曾用过的恰当例子，以说明迷信、精神分析和神秘主义概念之间的区别（《精神分析与迷信》，《国际精神分析杂志》第八卷，1922年）。Ossipow在俄罗斯一个偏远小镇结婚，婚后立即带着年轻的妻子前往莫斯科。在距离终点还有两个小时车程的一个车站，他突然想下车看看小镇。他以为火车会停足够长的时间，但几分钟后他回来时，火车已经开走了，他的妻子也在车上。家里的老护士听到这个消息后，摇着头说：“哎呀，这婚姻肯定不会有好结果。”当时，Ossipow对她的预言一笑置之。但五个月后，他与妻子分居，事后回想起来，他不禁将自己下车的行为视为对这段婚姻的“无意识抗议”。多年后，他做出这一举动的那个小镇对他而言变得意义非凡，因为那里是另一个人的故乡，而这个人后来与他有着密切的联系。当时，他完全不知道这个人的存在。但对他的行为的一种神秘解释是，他之所以在那个小镇下了开往莫斯科的火车（当时他的妻子也在车上），是因为他预感到将来会与这个人建立关系。

14 . There are some interesting problems of an economic nature connected with this, questions relating to the fact that the psychic processes aim at gaining pleasure and eliminating a sense of aversion. How it becomes possible to win back a name forgotten because of aversion by the use of substitute associations is an economic problem. An excellent work by Tausek (‘Entwertung des Verdrängungsmotivs durch Rekompense’ [‘Cancellation of the Motive for Suppression by Recompenses’], Internationale Zeitschrift für Psychoanalyse I, 1913) cites good examples of the way in which a forgotten name can be recovered if it can be associated with something, and that association can then maintain equilibrium between it and the sense of aversion expected in reproducing it.

14. 这与一些有趣的经济学问题相关，这些问题涉及心理过程旨在获得愉悦并消除厌恶感这一事实。如何通过替代联想来找回因厌恶而被遗忘的名字，这是一个经济学问题。陶塞克（Tausek）的优秀著作《通过补偿消除抑制动机》（Entwertung des Verdrängungsmotivs durch Rekompense，《国际精神分析杂志》第一卷，1913年）列举了一些很好的例子，说明如果能将一个被遗忘的名字与某种事物联系起来，并且这种联系能够维持名字与预期因重新出现该名字而产生的厌恶感之间的平衡，那么这个被遗忘的名字就可以被找回。

15 . This work has been purposely kept on a popular level, and intends only to ease the necessary acceptance of unconscious yet effective mental processes by citing a number of examples, while avoiding all theoretical assumptions about the nature of the unconscious mind.

15. 这项工作特意保持通俗易懂的水平，其目的只是为了通过列举一些例子来减轻人们对无意识但有效的心理过程的必要接受，同时避免对无意识的本质做出任何理论假设。

16 . I can give some indication of the mechanism of genuine forgetting, as follows: the material in the memory is in general subject to two influences, compression and distortion. Distortion is the work of the tendencies dominating mental life, and turns chiefly against those traces of memory that still have emotional connotations and are more resistant to compression. Traces that have become indifferent fall victim to the compression process without putting up any opposition, but we may observe that over and above this fact, tendencies to distortion will affect indifferent material if they cannot find satisfaction in material they would like to express themselves. Since these processes of compression and distortion influence the transformation of the material in the memory, it may be thought that the passage of time makes memories uncertain and unclear. However, forgetfulness is very probably not a directly temporal function. When traces of memory are repressed they can be shown to have undergone no change over quite a long period. The unconscious is timeless anyway. The outstanding and most surprising character of psychic fixation is that all impressions are retained just as they were absorbed, and moreover are retained in all the forms they assumed in further developments, a relationship which cannot be explained by any comparison from another sphere. According to this theory, therefore, every earlier stage of any material contained in the memory would be available for recollection, even if its elements have all long since changed their original connotations for later ones.

16. 我可以对真正遗忘的机制作如下简要说明：记忆中的素材通常受到压缩和扭曲两种因素的影响。扭曲是主导心理生活的倾向所致，主要针对那些仍然带有情感色彩且更难被压缩的记忆痕迹。那些变得无关紧要的痕迹会毫无抵抗地被压缩，但我们也可以观察到，除此之外，如果扭曲倾向无法在它们想要表达的素材中找到满足感，它们也会影响那些无关紧要的素材。由于压缩和扭曲的过程会影响记忆中素材的转化，人们可能会认为时间的流逝会使记忆变得不确定和模糊。然而，遗忘很可能并非直接由时间决定。当记忆痕迹被压抑时，它们在相当长的一段时间内都不会发生任何变化。无论如何，无意识是超越时间的。心理固着最显著也最令人惊讶的特征在于，所有印象都会被原封不动地保留下来，而且它们在后续发展中所呈现的所有形式也都会被保留下来，这种关系无法用其他领域的任何类比来解释。因此，根据这一理论，记忆中所包含的任何材料的每一个早期阶段都可供回忆，即使其所有元素早已从最初的内涵转变为后来的含义。
